fullDesc: On April 10, 2019 the Event Horizon Telescope team released the first image of a black hole, in the galaxy M87, 55 million light years away. It confirmed key predictions of Einstein's theory.
realFacts: The black hole has about 6.5 billion times the mass of the Sun
It took a global network of eight radio telescopes
Katie Bouman helped develop the imaging method
A picture of the Milky Way's black hole followed in 2022
